code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia (low arterial oxygen saturation), mild leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, elevated monocytes and basophils, mild hypercreatininemia, and low total protein. These findings may indicate an underlying infection or inflammatory process, possible mild renal impairment, and hypoproteinemia. Clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended to clarify the underlying cause and assess for potential hypoxic or hematologic disorders.
